You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBACT04C-002: The last account group is never written back at end of file

### given[0]: END-OF-FILE starts as 'N'.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   133        01  APPL-RESULT             PIC S9(9)   COMP.
   134            88  APPL-AOK            VALUE 0.
   135            88  APPL-EOF            VALUE 16.
   136 
>> 137        01  END-OF-FILE             PIC X(01)    VALUE 'N'.
   138        01  ABCODE                  PIC S9(9) BINARY.
   139        01  TIMING                  PIC S9(9) BINARY.
   140       * T I M E S T A M P   D B 2  X(26)     EEEE-MM-DD-UU.MM.SS.HH0000
   141        01  COBOL-TS.

### given[1]: The main loop repeats until END-OF-FILE = 'Y', and the test is made before each pass. Inside the loop, the ELSE branch that performs the account update is taken only when END-OF-FILE is not 'N' at the top of a pass.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['Y', 'N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   184            PERFORM 0200-DISCGRP-OPEN.
   185            PERFORM 0300-ACCTFILE-OPEN.
   186            PERFORM 0400-TRANFILE-OPEN.
   187 
>> 188            PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
>> 189                IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
>> 190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
>> 191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'

### given[2]: For each category balance record whose DIS-INT-RATE is not zero, 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST is performed inside the loop.
fields=['DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
   211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
   212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
   213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
>> 214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
>> 215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
   216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
   217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
   219                ELSE

### given[3]: 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST adds the record's monthly interest into WS-TOTAL-INT and right away performs 1300-B-WRITE-TX to produce an interest transaction.
fields=['WS-MONTHLY-INT', 'WS-TOTAL-INT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   463 
   464            COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT
   465             = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200
   466 
>> 467            ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT  TO WS-TOTAL-INT
>> 468            PERFORM 1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   469 
   470            EXIT.
   471 
   472       *---------------------------------------------------------------*

### given[4]: The interest transaction record is written to the transaction file at that point, before and separately from any account update.
fields=['FD-TRANFILE-REC', 'TRAN-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   496            PERFORM Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP
   497            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-ORIG-TS
   498            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-PROC-TS
   499 
>> 500            WRITE FD-TRANFILE-REC FROM TRAN-RECORD
   501            IF  TRANFILE-STATUS   = '00'
   502                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   503            ELSE
   504                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

### when[0]: Reading the category balance file returns status '10' (end of file), which sets APPL-RESULT to 16.
fields=['TCATBALF-STATUS', 'APPL-RESULT'] literals=['10', '16']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   326            READ TCATBAL-FILE INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD.
   327            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '00'
   328                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   329            ELSE
>> 330                IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '10'
>> 331                    MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT
   332                ELSE
   333                    MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
   334                END-IF
   335            END-IF

### when[1]: APPL-EOF (APPL-RESULT value 16) causes END-OF-FILE to be set to 'Y'.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['Y']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   335            END-IF
   336            IF  APPL-AOK
   337                CONTINUE
   338            ELSE
>> 339                IF  APPL-EOF
>> 340                    MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE
   341                ELSE
   342                    DISPLAY 'ERROR READING TRANSACTION CATEGORY FILE'
   343                    MOVE TCATBALF-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
   344                    PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS

### then[0]: In the same pass, the inner check END-OF-FILE = 'N' is now false, so no more processing is done in that pass.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   187 
   188            PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
   189                IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
>> 191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'

### then[1]: The loop condition END-OF-FILE = 'Y' is tested before the next pass, so the loop ends without evaluating the outer IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' again.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['Y', 'N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   184            PERFORM 0200-DISCGRP-OPEN.
   185            PERFORM 0300-ACCTFILE-OPEN.
   186            PERFORM 0400-TRANFILE-OPEN.
   187 
>> 188            PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
>> 189                IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
   191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD

### then[2]: After the last category balance record has been read, the account update (1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT) is performed once more for the last account group.
fields=['1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
   216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
   217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
>> 219                ELSE
>> 220                     PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   221                END-IF
   222            END-PERFORM.
   223 
   224            PERFORM 9000-TCATBALF-CLOSE.

### then[3]: As a result, the last account group is updated like every other account: its WS-TOTAL-INT is added to ACCT-CURR-BAL, its cycle credit and debit are set to zero, and its account record is rewritten. If the file is empty, no account is updated at all.
fields=['WS-TOTAL-INT', 'ACCT-CURR-BAL', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   348            EXIT.
   349       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   350        1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT.
   351       * Update the balances in account record to reflect posted trans.
>> 352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
>> 353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 355 
>> 356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
   357            IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS  = '00'
   358                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   359            ELSE
   360                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 137 declares END-OF-FILE PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":false,"reason":"Lines 188-191 show the UNTIL loop and the IF tests, but the ELSE branch that performs the account update sits at lines 219-220, outside the cited span."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 214-215 perform 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST when DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0."},{"clause":"given[3]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 467-468 add WS-MONTHLY-INT to WS-TOTAL-INT and then perform 1300-B-WRITE-TX."},{"clause":"given[4]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 500 writes FD-TRANFILE-REC FROM TRAN-RECORD inside the transaction-write paragraph, which is separate from the account rewrite."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 330-331 move 16 to APPL-RESULT when TCATBALF-STATUS = '10'."},{"clause":"when[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 339-340 move 'Y' to END-OF-FILE when APPL-EOF is true."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 191 tests END-OF-FILE = 'N' again after the read, so the record processing is skipped once it is 'Y'."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"PERFORM UNTIL at line 188 defaults to test-before, so once END-OF-FILE = 'Y' the loop exits without reaching the IF at line 189."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":false,"reason":"The ELSE at 219-220 runs only when END-OF-FILE is not 'N' at the top of a pass, but the loop exits as soon as it becomes 'Y', so this update is never reached after the last record, which contradicts the clause."},{"clause":"then[3]","supported":false,"reason":"Lines 352-356 only show what 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT does; they do not show that it runs for the last account group, nor anything about the empty-file case, and the loop logic implies the last group is not rewritten."}]}
